Deepfake

Jul 2023–Jan 2024

Face and voice swap

I collaborated on UNITY’s Deepfake grand project, which combined face swapping and voice conversion in a multimedia prototype presented at Techofest 2023. The voice service uses kNN-VC and gRPC to transform source audio toward a selected reference voice.

Multimedia AI
Project showcase

Problem

Connect face and voice transformation into a demonstrable multimedia workflow.

My role

Team contributor on the shared UNITY project, collaborating on its development and demonstration.

Approach

The team explored face swapping alongside a Python voice service built with PyTorch, kNN-VC, and gRPC, with a Flask interface for the broader prototype.

Voice workflow

The service accepts source audio and a reference-voice identifier, prepares mono audio, matches source features to the reference set, and returns converted audio bytes.

Result

The team presented the face-and-voice prototype at UNITY Techofest 2023 and published a project showcase.

Tools and methods

  • Python
  • PyTorch
  • Flask
  • gRPC
  • kNN-VC
